🗓
On October 18, Manama
hosted
the ninth
Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council (
#GCC
) Joint Ministerial Meeting for Strategic Dialogue, co-chaired by Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Bahrain, the current GCC Chair, Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani.
The meeting
was attended by the Foreign Ministers of
Kuwait
and
Saudi Arabia
, Ministers of State of
Qatar
and
the UAE
, Deputy Foreign Minister of
Oman
, and
GCC Secretary-General Jasem Albudaiwi
.
🇷🇺
🇧🇭
🇰🇼
🇸🇦
🇶🇦
🇦🇪
🇴🇲
In his remarks at the Plenary Session
,
Sergey Lavrov
noted that, over its 15 years, the
#RussiaGCC
Strategic Dialogue has established itself as
an effective and valuable mechanism
for constructively comparing assessments of key regional and international issues and discussing priorities in trade, economic, investment, cultural and humanitarian cooperation.
The Minister also stressed that advancing Russia’s multifaceted partnerships with the member states of this influential organisation is
one of our key foreign policy priorities
.
Sergey Lavrov noted
the continued intensity of political dialogue with the GCC Member States at the highest and high levels
, particularly the frank and trusting contacts between President of Russia
Vladimir Putin
and the Leaders of the Council’s Member States. He expressed
satisfaction with deepening business cooperation
and the steady growth in trade and mutual investment.
🤝
In this context, Sergey Lavrov and his counterparts from the Gulf states
stressed their shared interest in further diversifying mutually beneficial ties
between Russia and the GCC countries
, drawing on the coordinating role of intergovernmental commissions.
The participants held substantive discussions on t
he situation in the Middle East and North Africa
, including military and political tensions in the Persian Gulf. They reaffirmed that
there is no alternative to resolving existing differences through political and diplomatic means
, in strict compliance with international law and with full regard for the legitimate interests of all states involved in the conflict.
They stressed
the imperative of ensuring safe, secure and unimpeded navigation through international waterways
, including the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
Deep concern was expressed over rising tensions in the southern Arabian Peninsula
. The participants noted that normalising the situation in Yemen requires
the prompt launch of direct dialogue among all influential Yemeni political forces under UN auspices
, based on the settlement roadmap developed with Saudi Arabia’s direct involvement.
In discussing the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, the participants stressed
the need to create conditions for a lasting ceasefire in the Gaza Strip
and provide immediate humanitarian assistance to the enclave’s civilian population. They emphasised the importance of normalising the situation and ending illegal settlement activity in the West Bank. They reaffirmed
their shared support for a comprehensive settlement of
the Palestinian question
on the established international legal basis.
Sergey Lavrov set out in detail Russia’s assessments of developments surrounding Ukraine
. He reaffirmed Russia’s firm commitment to a comprehensive and lasting settlement of the Ukrainian crisis, which is possible only through
the complete and irreversible elimination of its
root causes
.
👉
It was agreed to hold the tenth Ministerial Meeting of the
#RussiaGCC
Strategic Dialogue in Russia in 2027.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On October 18, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Kuwait Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇰🇼 On October 18, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Kuwait Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah held a meeting in Manama on the sidelines of the ninth Ministerial Meeting of the Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council ( #GCC ) Strategic Dialogue. The Foreign Ministers discussed the further development of traditionally friendly Russia-Kuwait relations . 🤝 They reaffirmed the shared commitment of Moscow and Kuwait City to maintaining intensive political dialogue and strengthening mutually beneficial trade, economic, cultural and humanitarian cooperation . The Sides exchanged views on current international and regional issues, focusing on the situation in the Persian Gulf . They stressed the need to find ways to de-escalate tensions as soon as possible in this strategically important region. ❗️ The Foreign Ministers underscored that there is no alternative to resolving existing differences through political and diplomatic means , with full respect for the interests of all countries in the region involved in the conflict. #RussiaKuwait

🎙
Opening remarks
by Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at the ninth Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council (
#GCC
) Joint Ministerial Meeting for Strategic Dialogue
(Manama, October 18, 2026)
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
First of all, I would like to congratulate you on
the 45th anniversary of the establishment of the GCC
, which we mark in 2026.
Strengthening multifaceted, mutually beneficial ties with the GCC member states is
among the priorities of Russia’s foreign policy and diplomacy
.
The Strategic Dialogue with the Arab states of the Gulf was established
almost 15 years ago
in Abu Dhabi. Year after year, it has demonstrated its continued relevance and effectiveness, enabling f
rank and constructive exchanges on the most delicate global and regional issues
and
helping us map out further practical steps
to expand trade, economic, cultural and humanitarian ties between our countries.
☝️
The importance of such direct engagement can hardly be overstated amid a rapidly changing geopolitical landscape.
Russia and all GCC Member States
maintain regular, active contacts at the highest level
, giving powerful impetus to the comprehensive development of our relations.
We have established close foreign policy coordination
. I value the frank and trusting personal dialogue I enjoy with each of you, dear friends. I warmly recall our productive discussion during the previous,
eighth round of the Strategic Dialogue in Sochi in September 2025
.
📈
In 2025, Russia’s total trade with the GCC Member States grew by 45%
. Since 2021, almost every country in the Council has been a guest of honour at one of Russia’s major annual events,
the St Petersburg International Economic Forum
. We welcome this tradition and would like to see it continue.
The effectiveness of our economic cooperation depends to a considerable extent on
regional stability
. I look forward to discussing the Middle East’s most pressing problems in detail today, above all the situation in and around the Gulf.
The region remains gripped by a serious military and political crisis
that erupted following
the unprovoked US and Israeli aggression against Iran
, triggering a chain reaction across many other flashpoints in the Middle East.
❗️
Russia supports efforts to promote peace,
including those undertaken by the countries represented here
, aimed at preventing a return to full-scale war in the region.
We see
our updated Concept of Collective Security in the Persian Gulf
as our contribution to these efforts
. You are familiar with it. Earlier versions of this document have been discussed for decades with representatives of political, academic and expert circles in the GCC countries.
We believe that
the Gulf’s littoral states themselves must have the decisive say in determining how to ensure the secure development
of this entire, vitally important region.
Our Concept
is aimed precisely at creating conditions for direct dialogue among the Gulf’s littoral states and their neighbours, such as Iraq and Jordan.
🤝
Let me stress that
we sincerely cherish our friendly relations with all GCC members
and
remain firmly committed to steadily advancing our Strategic Dialogue
for the benefit of our countries and peoples.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On October 18, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Saudi Arabia Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇸🇦 On October 18, Foreign Minister of Russia Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Saudi Arabia Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud held a meeting in Manama on the sidelines of the ninth Ministerial Meeting of the Russia-Gulf Cooperation Council ( #GCC ) Strategic Dialogue . The Ministers discussed priority issues in the multifaceted Russia-Saudi Arabia relationship. Both Sides expressed their commitment to maintaining regular, frank political dialogue and expanding trade, economic, investment, cultural and humanitarian cooperation . They reaffirmed the importance of continuing effective cooperation between Russia and Saudi Arabia within the #OPECplus framework. The Ministers considered current international and Middle Eastern issues , including the situation in the Persian Gulf. They expressed concern over tensions in the southern Arabian Peninsula and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. Both Sides emphasised the importance of ensuring the safety of navigation and the unimpeded passage of vessels through all international waterways. #RussiaSaudiArabia
